detect.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no package.json, this is not a JavaScript or TypeScript project" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
found=0
for d in locales i18n translations lang; do
  if [ -d "$d" ] && [ -n "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.json' -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ]; then
    found=1
    break
  fi
done
if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: localization unavailable, no locale JSON catalogs found" >&2
  exit 78
fi
printf '%s\n' "$pm"

enabledShifts.fallback: compare locale JSON keys only; no translation or language judgment when the parity script is unavailable

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or the pinned range no longer resolves in the manager the lockfile names

packageManagerAdditions.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
declared="$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager"[^"]*"//p' package.json | cut -d@ -f1 | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "$declared" ] && [ "$declared" != "$pm" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: package.json names $declared, the lockfile names $pm" >&2
  exit 78
fi
ver="$(node -v 2>/dev/null)" || ver=""
major="${ver#v}"
major="${major%%.*}"
case "$major" in "" | *[!0-9]*) major=0 ;; esac
if [ "$major" -lt 20 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: this recipe needs Node 20 or newer, the host reports major $major" >&2
  exit 78
fi
found=0
for d in locales i18n translations lang; do
  if [ -d "$d" ] && [ -n "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.json' -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ]; then
    found=1
    break
  fi
done
if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: localization unavailable, no locale JSON catalogs found" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if grep -qE '"i18next-parser"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then
  exit 0
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm install --save-dev "i18next-parser@^9.0.0"; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm add --save-dev "i18next-parser@^9.0.0"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn add --dev "i18next-parser@^9.0.0"; fi

permissionRequirements: fallback: missing and unused keys are structural findings only; never invent translations
fallback: the parity script requires a locales, i18n, or translations directory with JSON catalogs
fallback: i18next-parser satisfies probe when configured; this recipe adds a key-diff script when none exists

probe.command:
for f in scripts/check-locale-parity.mjs scripts/check-locale-keys.mjs; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi
done
if grep -qE '"(i18next-parser|i18next-scanner|@lingual/i18n-check)"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
if grep -qE '"(i18n:check|locale:check|check-locale)"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
exit 1

rollback.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm uninstall i18next-parser
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm remove i18next-parser
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn remove i18next-parser
fi
rm -f scripts/check-locale-parity.mjs
